watch.en: Heat the butter until it just starts to sizzle, then cook over medium-low heat.
watch.de: Die Butter erhitzen, bis sie gerade zu zischen beginnt, dann bei mittlerer bis niedriger Hitze garen.

why.en: Eggs in a batter give a darker crust, which may or may not be what you want.
why.de: Eier im Teig machen die Kruste dunkler, was man wollen kann oder nicht.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Add a small amount of clarified butter and heat until the fat just begins to sizzle.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 8.1 Frying Methods, section Batters and Breading
sources.sentence: Adding eggs or sugar to a batter will result in a darker crust, which may or may not be desirable.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Continue cooking over medium-low heat until the eggs reach the appropriate degree of firmness.
